name: backlinkgpt
description: Connect BacklinkGPT to your agent: OAuth MCP server for prospect memory, SEO data, sending and reply detection, and the autopilot stages your agent can take over, plus six link-building skills: setup, finding link targets, judging pages, writing pitches, handling replies and negotiating, and the weekly report.

interface.shortDescription: Link building from your own agent: prospect memory, SEO data, sending and replies
interface.longDescription: BacklinkGPT runs link building in four stages: finding sites, judging pages, writing outreach and suggesting replies. Switch any of them off and your agent does that part with these skills. BacklinkGPT keeps the prospect and deal memory, runs SEO data tools, syncs Search Console and Bing, sends on a schedule with caps and pacing, and detects replies. Authentication runs through OAuth in your browser; tools that spend credits quote their cost before they run.
defaultPrompt: Use the BacklinkGPT setup skill to set up link building for my site
Find ten link targets for my site and judge them
Check BacklinkGPT for replies and answer them
